question.en: How frequently should a driver check rear-view and exterior mirrors while driving a heavy vehicle?
question.af: [AF] How frequently should a driver check rear-view and exterior mirrors while driving a heavy vehicle?
question.xh: [XH] How frequently should a driver check rear-view and exterior mirrors while driving a heavy vehicle?

question.st: [ST] How frequently should a driver check rear-view and exterior mirrors while driving a heavy vehicle?

en.B: Approximately every 5 to 8 seconds, and before any manoeuvre.
en.C: Only when coming to a complete stop.

memory_tricks.en: K53 Golden Rule: Always check mirrors, signal early, and verify safe clearances before performing any manoeuvre.
memory_tricks.af: K53 Goue Reël: Kontroleer altyd jou spieëls, dui betyds aan en verifieer veilige afstande.
memory_tricks.xh: Umthetho wa K53: Jonga izipili zakho, unike uphawu kwakukhawuleza, uqinisekise indawo ekhuselekileyo.
memory_tricks.zu: Umthetho we-K53: Bheka izibuko zakho njalo, unike uphawu kusenesikhathi, uqinisekise amabanga aphephile.
memory_tricks.st: Molao wa K53: Lebella diipone tsa gago ka mehla, fana ka letshwao esale hantle, mme o netefatse sebaka se bolokehileng.
